name: ZTL-11 wheeled assault gun
operator: People's Liberation Army Ground Force & Marine Corps
overview_md:
The ZTL-11 is China's wheeled assault gun — a fast, air-transportable 8×8 fire-support vehicle mounting a 105 mm gun, and the direct-fire heart of the PLA's light and medium wheeled combined-arms brigades. Part of the Type 08 (ZBL-08) family of wheeled armoured vehicles, it pairs the strategic and tactical mobility of a truck-like chassis with the punch of a tank-calibre gun.

The ZTL-11 is built for rapid-reaction and expeditionary roles where heavy tracked tanks are too slow or too heavy to deploy. Its 105 mm rifled gun fires standard tank ammunition and gun-launched anti-tank guided missiles, letting it engage light armour, fortifications and infantry, while its wheeled chassis self-deploys quickly over roads and can be moved by air. It is amphibious to a degree and equips both Army medium brigades and PLA Navy Marine Corps units.

For an analyst, the ZTL-11 reflects a global shift toward wheeled, rapidly-deployable fire support — paralleling vehicles like the U.S. Stryker MGS and Italy's Centauro. It gives China's light forces a deployable direct-fire capability for the kind of fast-moving, road-mobile operations that a contingency on the periphery — or an expeditionary deployment — might demand, complementing the tracked Type 99A and light Type 15 in heavier formations.

combat_history.event: Equips PLA medium wheeled combined-arms brigades and Marine Corps units; featured in parades and exercises.
combat_history.significance: Hardware of China's rapid-reaction wheeled forces.

modernization.description: Continued fielding across medium brigades and marines.
modernization.impact: Gives light forces deployable direct fire support.

vulnerabilities.description: Wheeled chassis limits armour versus a tank.
vulnerabilities.mitigation: Speed/mobility and avoidance; not an MBT substitute.

vulnerabilities.description: The 105 mm is weaker than a 125 mm against modern MBTs.
vulnerabilities.context: A fire-support gun, not a tank-killer.

operational_patterns.typical_deployment: Rapid-reaction direct fire support with wheeled medium brigades and marines.
operational_patterns.typical_task_group: Type 08 wheeled combined-arms brigades; complements tracked tanks.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: Both are wheeled 105 mm assault guns for light forces; the ZTL-11 is the PLA's equivalent.
A pioneering wheeled tank-destroyer the ZTL-11 parallels.
peer_comparisons.video_angle: The rise of the wheeled assault gun.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: The Type 15 is a tracked light tank; the ZTL-11 trades tracks for wheeled road speed.

doctrine.role: Wheeled rapid-reaction assault gun providing deployable direct fire support to light forces.
doctrine.employment: Self-deploys over roads/by air; engages armour, fortifications and infantry with a 105 mm gun.
doctrine.design_philosophy: Trade tracked protection for wheeled mobility and rapid deployability.
doctrine.threat_context: Gives China's light and marine forces a fast direct-fire punch for expeditionary and peripheral operations.
doctrine.comparison_frame: Read against the US Stryker MGS, Italy's Centauro and China's tracked Type 15.
